vanilla_changes.change: Bows and crossbows enchanted with Infinity can be used without having any arrow in the inventory.

getting_started: Enchant a bow or crossbow with Infinity and shoot.
editor_notes: Jar filename says neo; presumably a multi-loader build that loads on Fabric. Verify what is fired when no arrow is carried (assumed regular arrow).
name: Bow Infinity Fix
summary: Bows and crossbows with Infinity no longer need an arrow in the inventory to fire.
